title: 第一卷 第12章 全场最大赢家！
slug: 满门遗孀花甲老汉粮肉满仓
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

赌桌周围挤满了人。

窃窃私语声不断：

【熊哥号称鬼手，摇骰子从没输过……】

【这老头要栽了】

【看着吧，怕是要把孙女都输进去】

上官飞燕紧张得手心冒汗。

林骁却神色平静，仿佛笃定会赢。

熊天从怀里摸出一锭小银元宝，“砰”一声拍在桌上：“老头，跟我赌，十两起步，敢不敢？”

银元宝在油灯下泛着冷光，整整十两。

围观者发出低呼。

“好。”林骁也拿出十两，放在桌上。

第一局开始。

熊天抄起骰盅，手腕翻飞，骰子在盅里哗啦作响，如疾风骤雨。

他脸上带着得意的笑，这套手法他练了十年，鲜有失手。

林骁只是随意拿起骰盅，晃了三下，便扣在桌上。

【叮，检测到宿主遭受不法侵犯，现给予温馨帮助】

【接下来的四局中，宿主可任选一局输给对方】

林骁嘴角微扬，准备开盅。

“这么随意？”熊天冷笑。

“跟你比，用不着看。”林骁淡淡道，“盲开便是。”

“好！”熊天也扣下骰盅，“我也盲开！”

两人同时揭开。

熊天：二、三、五，十点。

林骁：二、三、六，十一点。

只大一点。

“赢了！”上官飞燕欢叫一声，飞快将二十两银子拢过来。

熊天脸色铁青，他从未摇出过这么低的点数。

“再来！”他咬牙，又摸出个大银锭，五十两。

林骁挑眉：“看来这些年欺男霸女，没少敛财，今天让你全吐出来。”

第二局，林骁依旧盲开。

揭开：三个五。

上官飞燕眼睛一亮，这已经很大了。

熊天却狞笑着揭开骰盅：三个六，豹子。

“哈哈哈！”熊天指着林骁鼻子，“死老头，知道厉害了吧？”

林骁难以置信，嘴唇微颤，眼神发直，装出一副惊慌的表情。

“老头，我们别赌了……”上官飞燕带着哭腔拉他胳膊，“求你了……”

“滚开！”林骁甩开她的手，眼睛发红，“我要赢回来！”

熊天见状，笑得更猖狂：“下一局，六十两起步，你还有钱吗？”

林骁数了数兜里的银子，只剩五十两。

熊天舔舔嘴唇，盯着上官飞燕：“这样好了，把你身边这小娘子押上，我跟你再赌一局，怎样？”

林骁看向上官飞燕。

她身子发抖，拼命摇头。

林骁摸摸她头，微微一笑：“放心，老头子不会拿你当赌注。”

他转身叫来赌场管事：“借十两。”

管事的是个瘦高个，打量林骁几眼，摇头：“您这年纪……还不上怎么办？”

林骁“哐”一声将杀猪刀砍在桌上，眼神凌厉：“老子是猎户，随随便便一头野猪卖百两。你觉得我还不上？”

管事被那杀气慑住，转身上了二楼。

片刻后回来，将十两银子放在桌上：“利息三分，十日为期。”

“行。”

林骁将六十两全推上桌。

上官飞燕面如死灰，后悔不该进来。

“开始吧！”熊天迫不及待。

两人摇骰。

这次林骁看了一眼，一、二、三，六点。

上官飞燕见状，不禁两眼一黑，六点简直太小了……

然而，林骁忽然一反常理，问：“要加注吗？”

熊天大笑：“看来你点数不小啊？加！加多少？”

“再加四十两。”

全场哗然，上官飞燕清楚劝不动，只能默默流下绝望的眼泪。

管事又送上四十两。

赌注堆成小山，整整一百两。

熊天也跟了，掏空钱袋。

林骁率先揭开骰盅：一、二、三，六点。

Page (1/3)

There was a crowd around the gaming table.

Whispers continued:

[Brother Xiong is known as the ghost hand, and he has never lost when rolling dice...]

【This old man is going to fall into trouble】

[Just watch, I’m afraid I’ll lose my granddaughter to it]

Shangguan Feiyan was so nervous that her palms were sweating.

Lin Xiao looked calm, as if he was determined to win.

Xiong Tian took out a small silver ingot from his arms and slapped it on the table with a bang: "Old man, bet with me, starting from ten taels, do you dare?"

The silver ingot shone coldly under the oil lamp, a full ten taels.

Onlookers groaned.

"Okay." Lin Xiao also took out ten taels and put them on the table.

The first game begins.

Xiong Tian picked up the dice cup, his wrists flew, and the dice clattered in the cup like a gust of wind and rain.

He had a proud smile on his face. He had practiced this technique for ten years and rarely failed.

Lin Xiao just picked up the dice cup casually, shook it three times, and then put it on the table.

[Ding, it has been detected that the host has been illegally violated, and we are now providing warm help]

[In the next four rounds, the host can choose any one to lose to the opponent]

Lin Xiao raised the corner of his mouth slightly and prepared to open the cup.

"So casual?" Xiong Tian sneered.

"Compared with you, there is no need to look." Lin Xiao said lightly, "Just open it blindly."

"Okay!" Xiong Tian also took the dice cup, "I'll do it blindly too!"

They both revealed it at the same time.

Xiong Tian: Two, three, five, ten o'clock.

Lin Xiao: Two, three, six, eleven o'clock.

Just a little bigger.

"Win!" Shangguan Feiyan shouted happily and quickly gathered the twenty taels of silver.

Xiong Tian's face turned pale. He had never produced such a low score before.

"Come again!" He gritted his teeth and took out another large silver ingot, fifty taels.

Lin Xiao raised his eyebrows: "It seems that I have been bullying men and dominating women over the years and amassing a lot of money. Today I will make you spit it out."

In the second game, Lin Xiao still opened blindly.

Revealed: Three Fives.

Shangguan Feiyan's eyes lit up, this was already huge.

But Xiong Tian opened the dice cup with a grim smile: Three sixes, leopard.

"Hahaha!" Xiong Tian pointed at Lin Xiao's nose, "Old man, do you know how powerful he is?"

Lin Xiao was in disbelief, his lips trembled slightly, his eyes straightened, pretending to be panicked.

"Old man, let's stop gambling..." Shangguan Feiyan cried and pulled his arm, "Please..."

"Go away!" Lin Xiao shook her hand away, his eyes red, "I want to win it back!"

Seeing this, Xiong Tian laughed even more crazily: "The next game starts at sixty taels. Do you still have money?"

Lin Xiao counted the silver in his pocket and found only fifty taels left.

Xiong Tian licked his lips and stared at Shangguan Feiyan: "Okay, how about I stake the little lady next to you and I'll make another bet with you?"

Lin Xiao looked at Shangguan Feiyan.

She was shaking and shaking her head desperately.

Lin Xiao touched her head and smiled slightly: "Don't worry, the old man won't use you as a bet."

He turned around and called the casino steward: "Borrow me ten taels."

The person in charge was a tall and thin man. He looked at Lin Xiao for a few times and shook his head: "What should you do if you are not old enough... at your age?"

Lin Xiao slashed the butcher's knife on the table with a clang, his eyes sharp: "I am a hunter, and I can just sell a wild boar for a hundred taels. Do you think I can't afford it?"

The steward was frightened by the murderous aura and turned around to go up to the second floor.

He came back after a while and put ten taels of silver on the table: "The interest is three cents, and the period is ten days."

"Okay."

Lin Xiao pushed all sixty pieces onto the table.

Shangguan Feiyan's face was ashen and she regretted that she should not have come in.

"Let's start!" Xiong Tian couldn't wait.

The two rolled the dice.

This time Lin Xiao took a look, one, two, three, six o'clock.

When Shangguan Feiyan saw this, her eyes darkened. Six o'clock was simply too small...

However, Lin Xiao suddenly went against the norm and asked: "Do you want to raise the bet?"

Xiong Tian laughed: "It seems that your points are not small? Add! How much more?"

"Add another forty taels."

The whole place was in an uproar. Shangguan Feiyan knew that he could not persuade him, so he could only silently shed tears of despair.

The steward presented another forty taels.

The bets were piled into a small mountain, a total of one hundred taels.

Xiong Tian followed suit and emptied his wallet.

Lin Xiao was the first to open the dice cup: one, two, three, six o'clock.
